summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results. The release details quarterly deliveries of 98,330 vehicles, total revenues of RMB25.7 billion, a net loss of RMB1.7 billion, and a vehicle margin of 9.4%, among other operating metrics. This is a routine periodic earnings announcement by the registrant, not a special-situations event. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is described. The filing serves to disclose financial performance to the SEC and shareholders, with no implications for merger, acquisition, or restructuring activity.
